target.title: Aviation Weather
target.description: Aviation Weather MCP — METAR, TAF, PIREPs, AIRMET/SIGMET, station info

env.name: PIPEWORX_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Pipeworx API key. Without it calls are anonymous and capped daily; a free key raises the cap.

checks.summary: Listed in the MCP Registry as io.github.pipeworx-io/aviation-weather.
Repository owner matches GitHub namespace pipeworx-io.

observation.network_policy: sinkhole: DNS is answered with placeholder addresses and every TCP connection and UDP datagram is captured inside the sandbox; nothing leaves it

tools.name: metar
tools.description: Real-time airport weather station observations (METAR report): current temperature, dew point, wind, visibility, cloud ceiling, altimeter, straight from that airport's own sensor. For airport-station temperature/conditions questions, e.g. current temperature at SFO/KSFO, ORD/KORD, LHR/EGLL. ids = comma-sep ICAO codes (KSFO,EGLL,LFPG).

tools.name: taf
tools.description: Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF) for one or more ICAO airport codes (e.g. KSFO,EGLL); returns forecast periods covering wind, visibility, and cloud ceilings for the next 24–30 h.

tools.name: pirep
tools.description: Pilot reports (PIREPs). Call with no args for recent US-wide reports (default CONUS box), or pass a station `id` for reports within `distance_nm` of it, or a custom `bbox`.

tools.name: sigmet
tools.description: Fetch all currently active SIGMETs (significant en-route weather hazards: convection, turbulence, icing, volcanic ash) from the US Aviation Weather Center; no inputs required.

tools.name: airmet
tools.description: Fetch all currently active AIRMETs (moderate turbulence, icing, IFR/mountain-obscuration advisories for general aviation) from the US Aviation Weather Center; no inputs required.

tools.name: gairmet
tools.description: Fetch Graphical AIRMETs from the US Aviation Weather Center; optionally filter by type (turb, ice, sfc_winds, lifr, ifr); returns GeoJSON-style hazard polygons.

tools.name: windsaloft
tools.description: Winds and temperatures aloft forecast from the US Aviation Weather Center; specify US region (us/bos/mia/chi/dfw/slc/sfo/alaska) and level (low/high); returns an ASCII table or JSON.

sandbox: Network: container namespace of the sinkhole (no route out).
limits: Install ran in a separate container with unrestricted network access (to fetch the package), with install scripts and source builds disabled.
File reads are not recorded; writes are measured against the freshly installed image.
Writes to tmpfs mounts such as /dev/shm are not visible.
Only tools declared read-only (or named with --safe-tool) were called, with synthetic inputs; every other tool's behaviour is unobserved.
Effects are attributed to the phase in which they appeared; background activity can land in a neighbouring phase.
One short session was observed; delayed or conditional behaviour may not have triggered.
Rewrites of files already changed in an earlier phase are detected by size and modification time while the server runs; a rewrite that keeps both, or one during shutdown, is not seen.
Non-DNS UDP is counted without its destination.

mismatches.summary: Tried to reach the network at startup, before any tool was called: gateway.pipeworx.io:443.

headline: Review before installing: what it did differs from what it claims.

suggestions.title: Pinned launch entry
suggestions.note: Generated from published metadata with the exact version. MCPAudit never reads or edits your client configuration; paste it yourself after review.

suggestions.title: Tool permissions (Claude Code settings)
suggestions.note: allow: declared read-only and called successfully with no effects seen. deny: declared destructive, injection-matching, or a high-severity mismatch. ask: everything not proven either way.

suggestions.title: Network egress
suggestions.body:
review gateway.pipeworx.io:443  # attempted during startup
deny *  # nothing else was attempted
suggestions.note: Hosts are attempts recorded by the sinkhole; none were reached. Allow only what the tools you use need.

suggestions.title: Filesystem writes
suggestions.note: Paths are where it wrote during the observed session; reads were not recorded.
